_note: Short-form industry-standard email disclaimers and common regulatory identifiers. These are templates, not legal advice — users should verify current wording with their regulator or in-house counsel.

US.disclaimer: ATTORNEY-CLIENT PRIVILEGE / WORK PRODUCT: This email and any attachments are confidential and may be protected by attorney-client privilege or the attorney work-product doctrine. If you are not the intended recipient, please notify the sender and delete this message.

UK.disclaimer: This email is confidential and may be legally privileged. It is intended solely for the addressee. If you have received this in error, please notify the sender immediately and delete all copies. Regulated by the Solicitors Regulation Authority.

AU.disclaimer: This email and any attachments are confidential and may be subject to legal professional privilege. If you are not the intended recipient, you must not use, copy or disclose this information. Please notify the sender and delete the email.

CA.disclaimer: This communication is intended only for the named recipient and may contain information that is privileged or confidential. If you are not the intended recipient, please notify the sender and delete the message. Unauthorised use or disclosure is prohibited.

US.disclaimer: Securities and advisory services offered through a registered broker-dealer / investment adviser. This email is for information purposes only and does not constitute an offer, solicitation, or recommendation. Not FDIC insured. May lose value. Check broker background at brokercheck.finra.org.

UK.disclaimer: Authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority. This email does not constitute a personal recommendation or financial advice. The value of investments can fall as well as rise and you may get back less than you invest.

AU.disclaimer: This email contains general information only and does not consider your objectives, financial situation or needs. Before acting, consider whether it is appropriate for you and read any relevant PDS or TMD. Authorised under AFSL.

CA.disclaimer: Registered with the Canadian Investment Regulatory Organization. This email is for informational purposes only and is not an offer to buy or sell, or a recommendation of, any security. Commissions, trailing commissions, and other fees may apply.

US.disclaimer: HIPAA NOTICE: This email may contain protected health information (PHI) that is confidential and intended only for the named recipient. Unauthorized review, use, or disclosure is prohibited. If you received this in error, please notify the sender and delete this message.

UK.disclaimer: This email may contain confidential patient information. If you are not the intended recipient, delete this message and notify the sender immediately. Registered with the General Medical Council.

AU.disclaimer: This email may contain personal health information protected under the Privacy Act 1988 and the Australian Privacy Principles. If you are not the intended recipient, you must not use, copy or disclose this information. Please notify the sender and delete.

CA.disclaimer: This email may contain personal health information protected under PHIPA / applicable provincial health privacy law. If you are not the intended recipient, please notify the sender and securely delete this message.

US.disclaimer: Equal Housing Opportunity. This email does not constitute a binding agreement or an offer to buy or sell real estate. All material is deemed reliable but is not guaranteed. Independently owned and operated.

UK.disclaimer: Property details are for guidance only and do not form part of any contract. Subject to contract and availability. Member of an approved property redress scheme as required by the Estate Agents Act 1979 and Consumer Rights Act 2015.

AU.disclaimer: All information is provided in good faith. Prospective purchasers should make their own enquiries and rely on their own investigations. Price guide is subject to change without notice. Licensed real estate agency.

CA.disclaimer: Not intended to solicit buyers or sellers currently under contract. Information is believed to be accurate but is not warranted. Independently owned and operated.

US.disclaimer: CIRCULAR 230 NOTICE: Any tax advice contained in this communication (including attachments) is not intended or written to be used, and cannot be used, for the purpose of avoiding tax-related penalties or promoting, marketing, or recommending any transaction to another party.

UK.disclaimer: This email is confidential and intended only for the named recipient. Any advice is based on the information you have supplied and is subject to our engagement letter. Regulated by our professional body for a range of investment business activities.
